prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: a single transparent vehicle sprite for a friendly carpool website, matching a realistic vehicle product render collection.
Primary request: Draw one recognizable Chinese DAYUN 大运 heavy truck, complete rigid-body dump truck with a bright red cab and matching red large high-sided cargo bed, black chassis, three axles and realistic large heavy-duty wheels. DAYUN styling with a tall squared cab, broad dark grille, silver emblem, clean readable small "大运" branding on the grille if possible. Compact but believable proportions.
Scene/backdrop: completely transparent background, actual alpha, no landscape or floor.
Style/medium: realistic detailed studio product visualization, crisp edges, gentle soft lighting, subtle contact shadow immediately beneath tires only. No toy/cartoon stylization.
Composition/framing: front-left three-quarter view, nose faces left, show front grille and the visible long side of cargo body. Whole truck centered in landscape 3:2 composition. Include ALL mirrors, tires, cab roof and rear cargo bed; leave generous transparent margin of at least 6% on all four sides, no clipping.
Materials/textures: glossy fire-engine red painted steel cab and cargo bed, dark windows, black rubber wheels, brushed metal wheel hubs and silver accents.
Constraints: exactly one complete truck; no people, no extra vehicle, no platform, no border, no watermark, no added caption, no scenery. Cargo bed level and closed; no dirt cargo or construction equipment. Keep clear truck silhouette readable at 640 x 440 pixels.
